svg.title: What the onmodel mini test found
svg.desc: Preliminary results from 52 photos of 9 products, two photos per cell, one image engine, with our own labels made with AI assistance. Small Print: 8 of 8 photos at 1K had garbled small print. At 2K: 0 of 4. Several Pieces: 2 of 2 photos of a two-tube set lost a piece with a generic prompt. With the product's rules: 0 of 2 at 1K, 1 of 2 at 2K. Fingers On The Label: 6 of 8 photos of one tin had fingers over the label, even though the prompt said not to. Hem Length: 5 of 8 dress photos took the hem length from the pose photo, not from the product. Model Reviewers: 40% agreement between two model reviewers on the same photos (kappa 0.12). One model reviewer alone is not enough. Text Rule: 12 of 12 garbled-print photos flagged by a free OCR rule, and 3 of 3 failures. It also flagged 2 of 17 good photos.
